title: The coefficient comparison at the pulled terminal object
statement: Let B be a topological commutative ring and eR an isomorphism from the sheafification of the constant ring presheaf ULift B on the coherent site of profinite sets to the continuous-function coefficient sheaf. For schemes T and U and a morphism j:U→T, put W = proEtTerminal Spec Z and W_X = pi_X^* W. Write q_X for the constant abelian presheaf sheafification unit followed by finiteDiscreteSchemeRingIso B X eR, and eta_j for condensedPushforwardHom of the continuous-function coefficient sheaf along j. Then q_T(W_T) followed by eta_j(W_T) equals q_U(j^* W_T). There is no finiteness, discreteness, nonempty-scheme, or nonzero-ring assumption.

proof.text: The unit_conjugateEquiv_symm identity for constantPullbackMonoidalIso identifies the sheafification unit at the pulled terminal object followed by the constant pullback comparison with the sheafification unit at the base terminal object followed by the inverse-image unit. Naturality in the coefficient map eR extends this to q_X = q0 followed by the unit of pi_X. The generic sheaf calculation is proved in constantPullback_unit and constantPullback_unit_map.

The mate identity unitAlgHom_comp_map_condensedPullbackHom rewrites the coefficient pushforward as the adjunction unit followed by the pushforward of condensedPullbackHom. Rewrite the latter with condensedPullbackHom_eq, then apply unit_comp_lowerStar_map_unit_comp_upperStarComp to j and the structural maps to Spec Z. This identifies the unit at T followed by the coefficient map with the unit at U followed by the congruence and composition comparisons of pushforwards. These are the restrictions along pullbackCongr and pullbackComp. The calculation is made for arbitrary sheaves before specialization.

For a map q from a constant presheaf, naturality gives q(X) followed by restriction along X→Y equal to q(Y). Apply this twice to remove the two restriction maps. Combine this with the two terminal unit formulas and specialize to the continuous-function coefficient sheaf and the given eR.

theorem finiteDiscreteCoefficient_coefficientUnit_pushforward_terminal
    (eR : Sheaf.sheafifyRingPresheaf.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) ((Functor.const Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ).obj
        (RingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} B))) ≅ Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} B)
    (T U : Scheme.{u}) (j : U ⟶ T) :
    ((sheafificationAdjunction (ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}).unit.app
        ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} B))) ≫
      (finiteDiscreteSchemeRingIso B T eR).hom.hom).app
        (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ (toSpecZ T)).obj
          (proEtTerminal specZ.{u}))) ≫
        (condensedPushforwardHom (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} B) j).hom.app
        (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ (toSpecZ T)).obj
          (proEtTerminal specZ.{u}))) =
    ((sheafificationAdjunction (ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}).unit.app
        ((Functor.const U.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} B))) ≫
      (finiteDiscreteSchemeRingIso B U eR).hom.hom).app
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ j).op.obj
          (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ (toSpecZ T)).obj
          (proEtTerminal specZ.{u}))))
